bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/compose.rs (midi(), pitches()), springboard/apps/daw/src/dsp.rs (mtof), springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (Bluetooth management socket, audio-class devices only)
summary: BifrOSt has no MIDI device I/O, no MIDI message encoding (1.0 or UMP), no MIDI driver, network or Bluetooth MIDI profile, and no app SDK API for MIDI. The only MIDI-related code is note-number math in the DAW (note names to pitch, pitch to frequency), which is a small part of what a MIDI note carries.

features.feature: MIDI Services (clients, ports, device and entity lookup)
features.apple: MIDIClientCreate, MIDIInputPortCreateWithProtocol, MIDIOutputPortCreate, MIDIGetNumberOfDevices, MIDIPortConnectSource, MIDIReceiveBlock (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremidi/midi-services)
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-core-midi, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No client, port or endpoint code. Searches for snd_seq, /dev/snd/seq and rawmidi in the repo return nothing. Input devices in springboard/src/bare/input.rs are evdev keyboards, mice and touch only.

features.feature: MIDI System Setup (driver and external device management)
features.note: Wave 5 (w5-core-midi, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No system-wide MIDI device registry. Hotplug for audio devices is in springboard/src/media/ and springboard/src/bare/input.rs, not for MIDI.

Wave 5 (theme-04, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The system layer pairs and tracks Bluetooth devices and classifies audio-class devices. There is no MIDI GATT service support and no app-facing SDK API for it.

features.apple: MIDI1UPNoteOn, MIDI1UPControlChange, MIDI2NoteOn, MIDI2PitchBend, MIDIMessage_32, MIDIMessage_64 (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremidi/midi-messages)
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/model.rs:152 (note struct: pitch p, velocity v in 0..1)
features.note: The DAW note model holds a pitch number and a velocity. There is no encoding to or from MIDI 1.0 bytes or Universal MIDI Packets, and no control change, pitch bend or SysEx support.

features.feature: Note number to pitch and frequency
features.note: Covers note names (C#4, Bb2) to note numbers and note numbers to Hz. The per-note attribute types (pitch, manufacturer-specific, profile-specific) have no counterpart.

features.feature: MIDI Thru Connection (play-through, value maps, transforms)
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-core-midi, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No routing layer between MIDI sources and destinations. No transform tables.
The LAN code (springboard/src/net/share.rs, UDP beacon on port 5354) does not carry MIDI sessions.

features.feature: MIDI Drivers (driver plug-ins and device lists)
features.note: The Apple driver plug-in model is specific to macOS. The Linux counterpart would be the kernel ALSA sequencer, which BifrOSt does not use for MIDI.

features.feature: MIDI Capability Inquiry (MIDI-CI discovery, profiles, property exchange)
features.note: No MIDI-CI discovery, profile or property exchange code.

gaps: No MIDI device I/O for apps: no client, input or output port, and no source or destination enumeration (MIDI Services).
No MIDI 1.0 or UMP message encoding and decoding; the DAW note model stores only pitch and velocity (model.rs:152).
No MIDI over Bluetooth LE (BLE MIDI service) on top of springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs.
No USB or hardware MIDI device hotplug, no system-level MIDI device registry, and no virtual endpoints.
No MIDI thru routing, value maps or transforms.
No MIDI-CI discovery, profiles or property exchange.
No app-facing SDK API for MIDI. The SDK (springboard/sdk/src/) has no MIDI module.
